title: Edit Lock
summary: Locks a finished or approved record and states that edits need re-approval before unlocking, so approved invoices aren't changed by mistake.
description: Locks the form in a disabled fieldset ("Locked by Priya after approval"), says before unlocking that any change needs re-approval, voids the approval only when something actually changes, and relocks after idleness, never mid-typing.
catches: Unlocking without knowing the consequence, via a confirmation step
Approvals voided by an unlock with no real change (only real edits void them)
Records left unlocked, by relocking after idleness
limits: A UI lock: the record can still be changed through your API
Re-approval is signalled through onEdit; your workflow must act on it
a11y: Lock state and edits are announced in an aria-live="polite" region
The unlock confirmation focuses its confirm button; Escape cancels and returns focus
After unlocking, focus moves to the first field
server: Enforce the lock on the server: reject edits to approved records unless the approval is voided and logged.
